description: List every option for an Acorn Harness custom wire harness: connector types (XT30, XT30(2+2), XT30 + JST GH), wire length range, power gauges, end A and end B terminations (straight, right angle up/down, unterminated tinned leads on end B), wire colors, extras (twisted or crossed signal pair, JST GH end B), the rules for combining them, required_choices (with the question to ask the user for each), optional_choices and their defaults, pricing rules, lead time, shipping and returns. Call it when you need the allowed values; it takes no arguments and changes nothing.
name: list_options
title: List wire harness options
